content: Maika Waiye Xisaona, Awa Atyo Iniyalahare Xisoma
Xisonae atyo Enore ityaninae, ixiyakawalaharenae. Hiyeta hoka Enore tyaonitere akereta xisaohena.
Maika xawenane xawaiyetyati xema tyaona, Cristo awaiyehenere wiso akereta, hoka wainihenere wihiyeta akereta, hoka airaxero airaxexe, exahe Enore awaiyetitere jihatyati xoaha akereta xisaona.
Enore anere hotyalinai tyare atyo xiso hoka maisa atyo ehekoreta xini xiraekakoita ohiro watyalisaka, masemaxematyati, maiyasetyati xoaha tahi.
Awatyo xiraeta iraiti kehaisakere, maomaxetahare, ewaxirahare. Hiyaiya, hatyoharenai atyo maisa xomanere xini. Xakore hoka maika xihalaharehena Enore kakoa.

Waiye xasema exeharenai: maisaiya hatya ohiro hiye tyaoniterehare, mahaiharenehare, mahakaiserexe, maiyasehatiye harenai xane tyaonita Cristo, Enore xoaha nawenakala nali. Hiyaiya, maiyaseti atyo enore metalahare xema nawenatyaka akerehare.
Hoka maika maisa xalahare hairaene maomaxetahare kakoa maoseraita xiso. Hiyaiya, hatyoharenai hiyeta atyoite Enore iniyalahare mohena hamatyakekotyasenai.
Hatyo hiyeta awa atyo nikare tyaoniterenae xema xisaona.

Hiyaiya, toahiya ene xisonai makaliroti koni xisaonita, xakore hoka Enore anerenai hotyalinai xisaohenere aoseta atyo xaokanatyakalati koni xisaonita. Hatyo hiyeta maika xaokanatyakalati koni nawenatyaseharenai akereta xisaohena.
Hiyaiya, xaokanatyakalati atyo kalore ekaotyakatita waiyexehaliti, waiyexe wenati, exahe aliterexe xoaha.
Xaiyateretyoa hoka xawaiyore Xekohaseti aokitereharenae kakoa.
Maika Awa Iniyalahare Xema Xisaona
Awa atyo haiyaharenae iniyalahare tyomiterenai akereta xisaona, hatyohare atyo makaliroti koniye. Xakore hoka maika xahotikihena tyotya hatyoharenai xaokanatyakalati ana.
Hoka aliterexe atyo kahaiharetyakere kairaetyakita hatyohare hameteneta tyomahiterehareha tahi.
Hoka tyotya kahotikisakehenere xaokanatyakalati ana xowaka atyoite kawaiyakehena hatyohare enómanenai.
Hiyaiya, waiye kawaiyakehetehenere atyoite xaokanatyakalati tyaona. Hatyo hiyeta exakere nexa:

content.text: “Hiso, nemakitere, hikaosehena! Hatityoahetehena hikamanaoseta, hoka Cristo ite aokanatya homana”.

content: Hatyo hiyeta waiyira xiyaiyehena xawenane. Awa atyo mawaiyoreharenai akereta xisaona, xakore hoka maika waiyorexenai akereta xisaona.
Awatyo haferakene hekoti xametaisa. Hiyaiya, kalikini wisaoniterenai ferakenenai atyo maisa waiyexe.
Awa atyo xihatyahare. Xaiyateretyoa Xekohaseti aokitereharenae waiyekahalaka xomana hoka aokitere akereta xisaona maheta.
Awa atyo vinhoxa xiserahena hoka xaheka. Hiyaiya, hatyoharenai atyoite ximawaiye nawenanekisase maheta. Xakore hoka maika Enore Nisekohare kakoa kaisere xisaona.
Xiyakaihakatyakakoahena haiyanai kakoa salmos nanekoare tahi, exahe xeratinai waiyexenai tahi. Xiyerehena xeratinai Xekohaseti anere xiyawaiyerene kakoa.
Maika xihalahare menehena Wexe Enore kakoa, tyotya xoalini hare hiyeta, Wiyekohase Jesus Cristo koamaniya xawenane hiyeta.
Xaiminijitere Cristo akeretaira xaiminisakakoahena.
Kaiyanityorenae Exahe Kaiyaneneronae
Ohironae, xexanenenaira xaiminisa, Xekohaseti xaiminijitere akereta.
Hiyaiya, ena atyo haiyanityo xahehare, Cristo tyakekohatiyenae xahehare tyaonitere akereta. Cristo terota atyo waiyexe maniya mohenahitahene hoka hatyo terota eháreha.
Hatyo hiyeta xasemaxematya xexanenenae niraene, tyakekohatiyenae semaxemaitere Cristo niraene akereta.
Xasemehena, xiso exanenenae: xawaiyetyaira xexanityonae, Cristo awaiyetya haomanerenae hoka wainihenere enomanaha akereta.
Nikare tyoma haware mokahene Enore ana maheta. Tihehetahene one kakoa, hoka iyoma mohenahitene hairaene kakoa.
Nikare moka tyakekohatiyenai exema maniya tyaoniterenai, kasani hotikisaha hawaiyexehare, hawaiyene, makawe xomokoanehare, exahe maiyalaharehare enomana aoka hoka.
Maika enanae awaiyehena haiyanityonaeha, haháreha awaiyetyahitere akereta. Ena awaiyetiterehare haiyanityo atyo awaiyetyoawita.
Hiyaiya, maisa xala hare kirawanexe haháre, hoka tyaijitene, kaxaikotene harenai. Nikareta Cristo waiye kaxaikota hakaxaikoneharenae.
Hiyaiya, Cristo hare hiyetare atyo wiso.
Exakere Iraiti Waiyexe nexa:

content.text: Hatyo hiyeta hatya enaite halakisa hanexe, hanityo xoaha tyaona maheta haiyanityo kakoa hoka hatyo hinamanai atyoite haterore tyaoheta.

content: Kalore atyo exe metaharexe xakore hoka nomani atyo Cristo, exahe tyakekohatiyenae harenae tahi iraeta naoka.
Xomanere tehitiya: Maika xiso exanenenae hoka xawaiyehena xexanityonae xawaiyetyoawitere akereta, exahe xiso exanityonae hoka xaiminihena xexanenenae.
